skill.name: frontend-design
skill.usageExample: 帮我设计一个 AI 项目管理工具的首页，要简洁好看，让人一眼能看到项目进度、待办事项和数据。

description.zh: 构建或改造 UI 时做出独特、有意图的视觉设计的指南，覆盖美学方向、字体排印，避免模板化的千篇一律默认样式。
description.en: Guidance for distinctive, intentional visual design when building new UI or reshaping an existing one. Helps with aesthetic direction, typography, and making choices that don't read as templated defaults.
